text: [MIP-21] MeridianReserve gas optimisation, posted by kestrel.eth. TL;DR: we upgrade MeridianReserve to a gas-optimised implementation (packed storage slots, unchecked loop counters). Deposits and withdrawals get ~1% cheaper.
This is purely a gas optimisation, with no change to ownership. The Timelock stays in control of the Reserve.
The new implementation was reviewed internally by the Meridian core team. An external audit is planned after deployment.

3. Scope. The upgrade replaces the MeridianReserve implementation behind the existing UUPS proxy at 0x5FC8d32690cc91D4c39d9d3abcBD16989F875707. Storage layout is preserved. The Timelock remains the sole owner of the Reserve.
4. Gas. Benchmarks show deposit(uint256) falling from 48,712 to 48,390 gas and withdraw(uint256) from 53,104 to 52,877 gas.
@kestrel_builds: MIP-21 is live for voting, small gas win for every Meridian depositor. Also moving my ops to a fresh wallet 0x9F2C188225BaBb8aC51c8B49c850678558fEfb7B, update your address books.
